About

I’m a motion and graphic designer who turns concepts into visuals that capture attention and tell a clear story. My work covers branding and layout as well as motion graphics.

Beyond 2D design, I have hands-on experience in 3D modeling, digital sculpting, rigging and animation. I can take a project from the first sketch to a finished, moving piece, across brand campaigns, social content, explainers and character-driven projects.
